messages:
ida: Quick sync — we need to finalize the metrics contract for per-model/route SLO dashboards in Console. Goal: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT (time-to-first-token), and tokens/sec, all broken down by model, route, region, and deployment_variant.

ida: Asking runtime + infra to confirm what they can emit natively vs what console should derive. Also need sampling/ingest guidance to keep cardinality sane.

jamal: Runtime can emit: request_latency_ms histogram, ttft_ms histogram, tokens_processed_total counter + request_count. We can add labels: model, route, region, variant.

jamal: Example exposition:
```
redwood_runtime_request_latency_ms_bucket{le="10",model="rw-1-7b",route="chat",region="us-west-2",variant="v2"} 123
redwood_runtime_request_latency_ms_sum{model="rw-1-7b",route="chat"} 23456
redwood_runtime_request_latency_ms_count{model="rw-1-7b",route="chat"} 9876
redwood_runtime_ttft_ms_bucket{le="5",model="rw-1-7b",route="chat"} 567
redwood_runtime_tokens_processed_total{model="rw-1-7b",route="chat"} 1234567
```

jamal: We can pre-aggregate some quantiles at runtime to reduce ingest; or emit histograms and let TSDB do quantiles.

tom: Cardinality warning: model x route x region x variant will explode if customers create lots of routes. Need defaults: only emit at route_group or route_owner level by default.

maria: Console suggestion: panels should support 2-level rollup: choose primary dimension (model or route) and a secondary filter (region/variant). Default view = model-level. We can add a dropdown to collapse low-volume routes.

ashley: From SRE: retention + sampling policy required. Raw histograms for all routes for 7d, aggregated rollups (daily) for 90d. Sampling: route-level emit 1.0 for routes >1000 req/day, 0.1 for <1000. That reduces cost.

ida: Agree on retention/sampling. Can we add a sample_rate label on emitted metrics so ingest knows how to up-weigh counts? e.g., sample_rate="0.1"?

jamal: Yeah we can include sample_rate label. But note prometheus-style counters need to be adjusted server-side; better to emit scaled counters: tokens_processed_total_scaled = tokens_processed_total / sample_rate. Simpler for downstream.

tom: We should avoid high-cardinality freeform labels. Suggest route_owner and route_group enums instead of route_name for dashboard by default. route label only emitted when route is flagged as 'important'.

maria: For console panels: layout proposal — top row: overall P50/P95/P99 latency and TTFT (multi-model sparkline), middle row: tokens/sec heatmap by model, bottom row: per-route table with SLO status and recent regressions. Each panel links to trace logs.

ida: Ownership: eng-platform owns metric names & tagging schema; runtime owns emitter changes; console owns panel UX and derived rollups. Need a small contract doc (one pager) and a follow-up 30-min sync to sign off.

jamal: Quick question: do we want token/sec as instant rate (tokens/sec gauge) or aggregated per-minute? Instant is noisy. We can emit tokens_in_window_total{window="1m"} as a rolling counter.

ashley: Per-minute aggregation is fine for SLO dashboards. For alerting we can use 1m or 5m windows.

ida: For SLO thresholds, product wants default P95 latency SLOs per tier (free/prod/enterprise). We'll add tier label where available.

tom: Also: sampling plan must be enforced at ingress (edge) and documented in the contract. Otherwise customers will overload metrics.

maria: Console needs consistent metric units: ms for latency, ms for TTFT, tokens/sec as integer. Also prefer quantile reconstruction from histograms rather than precomputed quantile labels to avoid drift.

jamal: We'll push a runtime PR with metric names + example instrumentation this week. Will include a feature flag to enable route-level emissions.

ida: Great. Action items: jamal — PR with schema + example by EOD Fri, tom — propose cardinality limits & route flagging policy, maria — mockup panel layout and wire interactions, ashley — finalize sampling/retention numbers and alert windows. I'll schedule a 30-min signoff (invite to eng-platform + eng-runtime + eng-sre + console).

console-bot: Deploy notice: metrics-schema-docs (branch: slo-telemetry) deployed to staging at 1722223500.

tom: one more — please include a tag "emission_version" so we can roll forward breaking changes without confusion.

jamal: will do emission_version label. Also adding route_group label.

ida: Thanks all — filing the contract draft into the docs repo and will ping once the meeting invite is live. :thumbsup:
